changeSet.sql:
create table konfiguration_version ( version int not null constraint konfiguration_version_pk primary key constraint konfiguration_version_nummer_ck check (version > 0), zeit timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(), wer text not null, grund text, quelle text not null constraint konfiguration_version_quelle_ck check (quelle in ('APP', 'DATEI', 'SEED', 'KOMMANDO', 'MIGRATION')), inhalt jsonb not null constraint konfiguration_version_inhalt_ck check (jsonb_typeof(inhalt) = 'object'), sha256 varchar(64) not null constraint konfiguration_version_sha256_ck check (sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') );
alter table dokument add column konfiguration_version int not null default 1; alter table dokument_version add column konfiguration_version int not null default 1;

create function konfiguration_version_nur_einfuegen() returns trigger language plpgsql as $$ begin raise exception 'konfiguration_version: nur Einfügen erlaubt (% verweigert)', tg_op using errcode = 'insufficient_privilege'; end $$
